study_route: documented adoption and acceptance of existing benchmark evidence

data.within_split_duplicates: preserve for reproduction; 16 excess train rows and 3 excess test rows

training.optimizer: AdamW, recorded PyTorch 2.10 defaults except explicit lr and weight_decay
training.positive_class_weight: 1214/3484; represented as float32 by the reference pipeline
training.precision: CUDA float16 autocast with float32 parameters and GradScaler
training.batchnorm_running_statistics: fixed in every phase; affine parameters may update inside trainable modules
training.module_mode: model.eval with classifier head.train; gradients enabled for declared trainable modules
training.checkpoint_rule: fixed final epoch, no best-test or best-validation checkpoint selection
training.paired_control: ResNet frozen and partial share the identical epoch-2 state; fresh optimizers, same adaptation lr, three more epochs, batch order and augmentation seed schedule

evaluation.secondary_precision: FP32 on the same real images for numerical agreement
evaluation.aggregation: mean of per-seed metrics; sample SD across three seeds; no probability ensemble

statistics.case_unit: 621 exact-image-hash test clusters, resampled with replacement; not stratified
statistics.paired_resampling: same sampled cases and seed indices across configurations
statistics.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles for mean AUROC and declared AUROC differences
statistics.claims: descriptive benchmark evidence with exploratory uncertainty, not equivalence or confirmatory clinical evidence

resources.training_time: wall time for training and scheduled validation, excluding setup and downloads; shared ResNet warm-up counted once for actual total
resources.weights_size: FP32 model state dictionary without optimizer/scaler state, retaining native buffer dtypes
resources.memory: peak CUDA allocated memory, not reserved memory or total system usage

latency.inputs: fresh random device-resident tensor per mode/round; same shape, not identical values
latency.scope: model forward only; excludes image decode/preprocessing/transfer
latency.summary: median of round medians; p95 summarized separately; median of round speedup ratios with round range

synthetic_training_probe.inputs: synthetic random tensors; alternating binary targets
synthetic_training_probe.scope: full forward/backward/AdamW step excluding preprocessing and transfer; disposable copies

resources.probe_stop_rule: stop current architecture after an OOM or a completed case above 70% of physical VRAM in peak allocation; always honor listed maximum batch
resources.capacity_claim: largest tested successful workloads only, not the absolute hardware ceiling

change_control.default: reuse existing eligible evidence; no new training without a failed acceptance criterion or an explicit new experiment purpose
change_control.failed_run_policy: record failure, diagnose a concrete issue, rerun affected comparisons consistently; no score-based selective retention
change_control.archive: preserve reference source and recorded evidence; future outputs use versioned active paths
